newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney sees mild temps in U.S. Northeast.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney sees mild temps in U.S. Northeast.

text.p: Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis sees temperatures in the U.S. Northeast moderating to five to nine degrees above normal by Thursday, with temperatures turning normal by Saturday.
Davis expects essentially the same weather pattern for the Midwest, with above-normal temperatures expected to hit there by Tuesday.

Traders said heating oil futures on New York Mercantile Exchange declined on the bearish forecasts by Davis and other private forecasters. At 1409 EST, January heating oil was off 2.71 cents at 71.95 cents a gallon.
Weather Services Corp predicted mostly seasonable to milder-than-normal weather in the Northeast and Midwest during the coming week.
